recommended_actions: Review whether recurring meetings this week can be shortened or made async.
Run a workload check-in this week — back-to-back scheduling is elevated team-wide.
Encourage agenda-required norms for recurring meetings.
Check whether after-hours meetings are avoidable for most attendees.
Consider protecting a midday buffer window on the team calendar.
